scope: synthetic engineering only; no real market rows, account binding, or publication

rules.cutoff: declared in AdvicePolicy before produce; never inferred from member times
rules.per_member_clock: each member needs a concrete consumer-visible available_at <= decision_cutoff
rules.required_missing: INPUT_NOT_READY; no formal package is emitted
rules.empty_advice: only when all required members are admitted and no candidate was injected
rules.published_at: injected real publish instant; never backfilled; must not precede cutoff
rules.append_only: same market_date with different content refused; same (id,version) refused; receipt time must equal decision_set published_at
rules.blocked_reason: input_blocked carries only STALE_MARKET_INPUT or INPUT_UNAVAILABLE (P12 validate_decision_set)
rules.publishable: false when any decision is input_blocked
rules.evaluation_receipt: required on both empty and non-empty paths; bound to batch+policy+cutoff+candidate ids; completed_at <= cutoff; qualified_count equals entry_plan count
rules.candidate_evidence: expert/risk digests must equal batch+policy+rule+opportunity bound digests; unknown reason code or mismatch -> input_blocked
rules.intake_clock: intake_received_at and intake_verified_at must be <= decision_cutoff
rules.p12_precheck: cutoff on market_date; published_at >= cutoff; next_session > market_date; unique ids and live security codes; entry window on next_session; no duplicate market_date in one package
rules.digest_surfaces: file_sha256 = on-disk bytes; decision_set_digests = canonical JSON; p12_package_digests = P12-validated object binding digest
